dedupe_keys.name: cdema situation reports regional response updates on hurricanes and other disasters affecting caribbean participating states

description: CDEMA is the regional disaster agency of the Caribbean, and its situation reports track the coordinated response each time a hurricane or other major event strikes a participating state. Reports are numbered through an event and summarise the situation, the actions of CDEMA and its partners, the teams deployed, relief shipments and logistics, and support to health services. The most recent series when read covered Hurricane Melissa in Jamaica in late 2025: report 7 described relief shipments and the rapid needs assessment team in the field, report 17 a logistics system training with the World Food Programme for Jamaica Defence Force personnel, and report 18 a Barbados field medical hospital supporting care in Savanna-la-Mar. Reports are free to read on the CDEMA website, some with files available to download. Caveats: these are narrative updates, not data tables, the archive shown on the page is short, and no licence is stated. Coverage is the CDEMA participating states across the Caribbean. Simulation uses: timelines of regional relief deployment and health service support for response models of Caribbean hurricanes. Related records: the Sri Lanka DMC situation reports (data-dmc-sri-lanka-situation-reports) are a comparable national series.
